entities.name: Henryk Trębicki
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Henryk Trębicki was a Polish bantamweight weightlifter. He competed at the 1964, 1968 and 1972 Olympics and won a bronze medal in 1968, placing fourth in 1964 and 1972. He won a silver medal at the 1971 world and a bronze medal at the 1965 European championships. He also placed third at the 1970 World Championships, but was disqualified after a positive doping test.
